acip: SMAD KYI ME LCE HAm LA PHOG PAS DE LAS BYANG SEMS DKAR PO SKUD PA LTAR SKYA NAR GYIS BABS PAS SMAD KYI ME RLUNG THUR DU MNAN TE, SNYING GA'I THAD DU 'BAR 'DZAG SKRA SHAD 'DZAGS PA LTA BU LA SEMS GTAD PA DGOS TSUL SOGS GSUNGS,
english: At the end of this process, the flame of the fire of the lower half strikes the hang letter, and this makes the white element of enlightenment ooze down in a thin, elongated stream, like a long string.  This presses down upon the fire and wind of the lower half.  Our Lama described how then we were to focus our mind at the blazing and dripping at the heart, falling in so fine a stream that it resembles a single strand of human hair.  Other details He spoke as well.
